text:
emma_cs: Quick sync — Brineworks private gateway onboarding. Two immediate blockers: KMS key access failing for the infra role, and cross‑VPC route propagation not showing after peering. Can infra/security weigh in?

raj_infra: saw the logs earlier, thanks. Peering looks provisioned but routes aren't in the route table on Brineworks side. I asked their cloud team to confirm propagation; they said they enabled auto-propagation but we might need a static route for the mgmt subnet.

lia_pm: FYI customer is aiming to run a limited pilot next Thurs. If these aren't cleared we risk slipping the pilot and that pushes renewal/PO timeline. Noted as a potential renewal risk if pilot misses target.

sahil_sec: KMS error is "AccessDeniedException: user is not authorized to use the key" when the instance role exchanges creds. I checked the key policy quickly — it references account root ARN and an old role name. Brineworks provided a role ARN that doesn't match. Requesting the exact role ARN we should expect.

emma_cs: @raj_infra @sahil_sec i've pasted the customer's role ARN they sent earlier: arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/brineworks-llm-infer.

raj_infra: ok thanks. Policy currently allows arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/brineworks-infer-old, so that's the mismatch. I'll update our onboarding checklist and send a minimal policy snippet they can paste.

marta_support: looping their support contact catherine@brineworks — she confirms they rotated role names last month. She can update the policy but asked if Redwood can provide a one-click policy snippet.

emma_cs: can we give them a safe least-priv policy? need to avoid broad KMS access.

sahil_sec: suggest this scoped statement (share as snippet):

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowUseForBrineworksInfer",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::777888999:role/brineworks-llm-infer"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

sahil_sec: they'll still need a KMS grants path for the runtime; I'll open a quick runbook doc after this thread.

raj_infra: back to routing — @catherine if you're in channel plz confirm whether the Brineworks route table for 10.40.0.0/16 contains the peering attachment route. I can create a static route on our side but ideally both sides propagate.

ops-bot: Deployment check: private-gateway-peering-request-1712 created by raj_infra — status PENDING on brineworks-account-777888999

catherine (via marta_support): confirmed — their route table does NOT show the peering route. They said auto-propagation was on but cloud console shows no routes. They will re-run the peering acceptance and report.

lia_pm: action items backlog so far: 1) Update KMS key policy -> owner sahil_sec, ETA today EOD. 2) Confirm static route vs propagation -> owner raj_infra + brineworks, ETA tomorrow 10:00 PT. 3) Run canary with small inference traffic once routes + KMS fixed -> owner emma_cs, ETA Wed pilot.

emma_cs: also capture enablement ask from customer: they requested a 30m walkthrough on usage patterns and cost controls after pilot. Can we schedule? Lia can coordinate.

lia_pm: I can set 30m slot Thu 11:00 PT, holding tentatively. If pilot slides we'll move.

marta_support: customer feedback note: they liked the dashboard preview but want clearer logs mapping from request-id -> KMS key id. Filing that as feedback for docs/console team.

emma_cs: thanks. small mitigation for renewal risk — i'll offer a one-time extension for pilot window if infra delays are on our side, which should reduce churn pressure. Lia will confirm pricing/legal ok.

sahil_sec: I'm drafting the KMS policy snippet and a short verification command for them: `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-brineworks-key` and `aws sts get-caller-identity` to confirm role. Will paste links to docs in the runbook.

raj_infra: i'll attempt a static route on our side as a stopgap and post command in thread when done. If brineworks accepts peering properly we can revert.

emma_cs: thanks all — let's reconvene here after sahil posts the policy and raj posts route result. tagging follow-ups: @sahil_sec (KMS policy), @raj_infra (route static), @lia_pm (scheduling), @marta_support (customer coord).

-- thread end --
